answer.text:
This information comes from internal conversations, not documented policy:

When using Accelevents, it is recommended to have just one event open per browser window. Team members have noted in Slack and ticket discussions that having multiple events open in the same browser can cause issues, such as settings or cache getting mixed up between events. If you need to work with more than one event at a time, the safest approach is to use different browsers or incognito windows for each event.

Source: Slack (#deal-desk, 2026-05-29) and internal ticket (2026-10-08). This is guidance from team experience, not official handbook policy.
